_readme: BLIND PROBE — the integrity check on the NLP benchmark.
benchmark.json has a dev split (tuned on) and heldout splits (written as tests).
In practice a held-out split stops being held out the moment someone develops
against it: you read the failures, you fix them, and the score climbs toward 100%
without the parser getting proportionally better at language it has never seen.
That is exactly what happened here — held-out exact-triple read 55% before a
parser rewrite and 100% after, while this probe scored 63% on the same parser.
These cases exist to measure that gap. RULES OF USE:
1. Never fix a parser bug BY LOOKING AT A CASE IN THIS FILE. Fix the general
2. If a case here does inform a fix, it is burned: move it into benchmark.json
as a heldout case and write a fresh probe case to replace it.
3. Quote THIS number in the report and the deck, not the tuned-split number.
Gold format matches benchmark.json so the same scorer logic applies.
